Independent destructive-time-course evidence. The Issue 226 independent-time-course fixture
experiment uses the rna layer to assess the declared condition target contrasts treatment with
control. (A) Component PC1 shows individual observations and stored population trajectories;
the standardized condition-by-time interaction is 1.98 [1.98, 2.01]. (B) Component PC2 shows
individual observations and stored population trajectories; the standardized condition-by-time
interaction is -0.00 [-0.11, 0.02]. Points show independent biological observations. labels
give biological sample counts per design cell. lines show stored population trajectories. The
analysis unit is independent biological observation; the design is independent time course; the
estimand is condition-by-time interaction on the rank scale; time is recorded as day;
adjustment uses batch. Facet labels report stored interaction estimates and 95% intervals;
resampling recurrence remains in the evidence. Raw p-values are retained; q-values use Holm
correction across declared components within each metadata field and evidence variant. No
acceptance threshold is applied. Trajectory evidence is exploratory and does not establish
biological validity.
